Procedures for Shareholders to Propose                                            股東提名人選參選董事的程序
Candidates for Election As a Director
Pursuant to the requirement of the Articles of Association, any shareholder       依 據 公 司 章 程 規 定，單 獨 或 合 併 持 有 公 司 有

          Effective interest method is the method that is used in the                      實際利率法是指計算金融資產或金融

          future cash flows through the expected life of the financial asset or            債在預計存續期的估計未來現金流
          financial liability to the gross carrying amount of a financial asset or         量，折現為該金融資產賬面餘額或該
          to the amortized cost of a financial liability. When calculating the             金融負債攤餘成本所使用的利率。在
          effective interest rate, the Group shall estimate the expected cash              確定實際利率時，在考慮金融資產或
          flows by considering all the contractual terms of the financial assets           金融負債所有合同條款（如提前還款、
          or liabilities (for example, early repayment, extension, call and                展期、看漲期權或其他類似期權等）的

                                                                                           預期信用損失。

          the amount of deferred tax assets that can be recognized, based                的判斷來估計未來取得應納稅所得額
          upon the likely timing and level of future taxable profit together             的時間和金額，結合納稅籌劃策略，
          with future tax planning strategies.                                           以決定應確認的遞延所得稅資產的金

          Defined benefit obligations                                                   設定受益義務
          The Group operates defined benefit schemes for its staff in some              本集團部分境外子公司為符合條件的
          overseas subsidiaries who meet conditions. The scheme requires                員工運作若干設定受益計劃，該計劃
          that contribution be made to an independently administered fund.              要求向獨立管理的基金繳存費用。在
          Under the scheme, staff are entitled to enjoy retirement benefit              該計劃下，員工有權享受設定受益計
          provided for under defined benefit of the plans.                              劃約定的退休福利。


          The Group’s defined benefit scheme is one requiring contribution              本集團的設定受益計劃是離職後退休
          after termination of service. The scheme requires that contribution           金計劃，該計劃要求向獨立管理的基
          be made to an independently administered fund. The scheme is                  金繳存費用。該計劃以基金為法律形
          administered by an independent trustee in the legal form of a fund.           式，並由獨立受托人進行管理，其持
          The assets held under the fund is held separately with assets of the          有的資產與本集團的資產單獨分開。
          Group. The trustee is responsible for the investment strategies of            受托人負責確定該計劃的投資策略。
          the scheme.


          The trustee assesses the level of capital of the scheme. The                  受托人審核計劃的資金水平。該審核
          assessment includes asset-liabilities matching strategies and                 包括資產－負債匹配策略和投資風險
          investment risk management strategies. The trustee determines                 管理策略。受托人根據年度審核的結
          the amount to be deployed based on the result of its annual                   果決定應繳存額。
          assessment.


          The scheme is exposed to interest rate risk, risk of change of                該計劃受利率風險、退休金受益人的
          anticipated age of beneficiaries of the pension, and risks of the             預期壽命變動風險和證券市場風險的
          securities market.                                                            影響。

          the quantitative analysis of historical statistics (such as ratings of           集團考慮歷史統計數據（如交易對手評
